scope: Per-run input p95 is the nearest-rank sample (rank 92 of 96). Tail samples are at or above that threshold. parseEnd and terminal command-boundary end are stored endpoint-relative timestamps; boundary-to-presentation is their difference, not GPU-device execution time. Optional trace checkpoints use the exact selected animation identity to recover input-relative clock. An elevated pre-parse/echo delay does not establish its cause or rule out an indirect scheduling regression.
